name: Kamil Czopek
bio: Kamil is a consultant, a manager and a seasoned iOS developer with JEE background. Strongly interested in internet and mobile marketing. Occasionally, Kamil likes to utilize the humanistic side of his nature by writing magazine articles, e-books or traditional book chapters, recording video training sessions or by conveying his message in some sort of the ATL media - like radio or TV show. A husband to the one and only :)) and a father of two. Always loves to grab a cup of a decent coffee and sometimes happens to act like a foodie…
